role: The AI scheduler every EntityLiving runs: holds the task entries and the executing list, ticks at rate 3, decides by priority and mutex bits which tasks may run, and drives shouldExecute/continue/start/reset/update.

members.name: taskEntries
members.note: ai_tasks.entries[AI_MAX_ENTRIES] with n; a fixed array instead of the ArrayList

members.name: executingTaskEntries
members.note: ai_tasks.executing[AI_MAX_ENTRIES] with nexec, entry indices instead of object references

members.name: theProfiler
members.note: profiler section bookkeeping only; dropped with the profiler

members.name: tickRate
members.note: the native loop hardcodes % 3; the Java field defaults to 3 and is never changed

members.name: EntityAITasks
members.note: the struct is embedded in struct living and zero-initialized

members.name: addTask
members.note: add_task/add_task_full for normal tasks, add_target_task/add_target_task_full for target tasks

members.name: removeTask
members.note: removes by task class, resets it if executing, and renumbers the executing indices

members.name: onUpdateTasks
members.note: the tick-rate gate, the continue-or-reset pass, the shouldExecute pass with a deferred start list, then start and update loops in the same order

members.name: canUse
members.note: priority/mutex test over the executing entries (a mask kept through the 3-tick pass, lane/mobtick); isInterruptible is true for every task (EntityAIBase has no override), so only the executing tasks are read

notes: The task identity is an AIC_* enum value in the engine instead of an object reference; the mutex bits and priorities live in the same ai_entry. EntityAIBase (the abstract task base) is folded into the ai_task struct and the ai_should_execute/continue/start/reset/update dispatch. lane/villagetrade 2026-09-27: the tail-only evidence (X-01/X-02) now points at the full re-records persist-village-full-s42, whose native replay starts before the behaviour.
